def get_edge_status(r, c):
    """Returns tuple describing edge status"""
    is_top_row = r == 0
    is_bottom_row = r == h - 1
    is_left_col = c == 0
    is_right_col = c == w - 1
    
    num_adjacent_edges = sum([is_top_row, is_bottom_row, is_left_col, is_right_col])

    for dr in [-1, 0, 1]:
        for dc in [-1, 0, 1]:

            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if (nr == 0 or nr == h-1) and (nc == 0 or nc == w-1):
                edge_neighbors += 1

        'on_edge': num_adjacent_edges > 0,
